entries.question: Cardiology appointment
entries.answer:
To book a Cardiology appointment at King George's Medical University (KGMU):

* Online registration is mandatory.
* Bookings can be made through the Online Registration System (ORS) at [ors.gov.in](https://ors.gov.in), the ABHA / Health Care App, or by sending an SMS (`Appointment [Patient Name]`) to **8887019134**.
* The OPD slip fee is ₹50.
* OPD timings are Monday to Friday (9:00 AM – 1:00 PM) and Saturday (9:00 AM – 12:00 PM); the ticket counter closes at 1:00 PM sharp.
* Outside-city patients must bring a valid referral for the specific department. Pre-booking is strongly recommended.
* For emergency cardiology care, please stabilize at the Trauma Centre first before transfer to LARI Cardiology across the Shah Mina Road belt.

entries.question: register for opd
entries.answer:
To register for an OPD appointment at KGMU, online registration is mandatory. You can use any of the following methods:

1. **Online Registration System (ORS):** Visit [ors.gov.in](https://ors.gov.in), select Uttar Pradesh, choose KGMU, pick your department and date, fill in your details, pay the ₹50 fee, and download your appointment slip.
2. **ABHA / Health Care App:** Register using your mobile number and OTP, then follow the same hospital selection process.
3. **SMS:** Send an SMS in the format `Appointment [Patient Name]` to **8887019134**.
4. **Walk-in:** Visit a ticket counter at KGMU with your Aadhaar number and active mobile number to complete the OTP verification, physical token generation, and ₹50 fee payment.

**Important Notes:**
- The OPD slip fee is **₹50** for all booking methods.
- OPD timings are Monday to Friday (9:00 AM–1:00 PM) and Saturday (9:00 AM–12:00 PM). The hospital is closed on Sundays.
- The ticket counter closes at **1:00 PM sharp**.
- Patients from outside Lucknow must bring a valid referral letter for the specific department. Pre-booking is strongly recommended.

केजीएमयू (लारी कार्डियोलॉजी) में कार्डियोलॉजी विभाग की अपॉइंटमेंट के लिए ऑनलाइन पंजीकरण अनिवार्य है। आप नीचे दिए गए तरीकों से अपॉइंटमेंट ले सकते हैं:

1. **ऑनलाइन (सुझाया गया):** [ORS की आधिकारिक वेबसाइट](https://ors.gov.in) पर जाएं, उत्तर प्रदेश चुनें, केजीएमयू (KGMU) चुनें, कार्डियोलॉजी विभाग चुनें, उपलब्ध तारीख चुनें और ₹50 का शुल्क भुगतान करके अपनी पर्ची डाउनलोड करें।
2. **मोबाइल ऐप:** ABHA या हेल्थ केयर ऐप के जरिए भी इसी प्रक्रिया से बुकिंग की जा सकती है।
3. **एसएमएस (SMS):** `Appointment [रोगी का नाम]` लिखकर **8887019134** पर भेजें।
4. **वॉक-इन (अस्पताल आकर):** आप अपना आधार कार्ड और चालू मोबाइल नंबर लेकर सीधे अस्पताल आ सकते हैं और काउंटर से पर्ची बनवा सकते हैं।

*ध्यान दें:* भारी भीड़ से बचने के लिए पहले से बुकिंग करना बेहतर है। यदि आप लखनऊ से बाहर के मरीज हैं, तो कृपया कार्डियोलॉजी विभाग का वैध रेफरल पत्र साथ लेकर आएं।

अधिक जानकारी के लिए आप लारी कार्डियोलॉजी के पीआरओ कार्यालय से **9415099528** पर संपर्क कर सकते हैं।

entries.question: how to get appointment
entries.answer:
To get an OPD appointment at KGMU, online pre-booking is strongly recommended to avoid severe wait times. The OPD slip fee is ₹50 across all booking methods. 

Here are the available booking methods:

1. **Online via ORS (Online Registration System):**
   - Visit [ors.gov.in](https://ors.gov.in).
   - Select **Uttar Pradesh** → **KGMU**.
   - Choose **New Appointment**, select the desired department, date, and time.
   - Enter patient details, pay the ₹50 fee, and download the appointment slip.

2. **ABHA / Health Care App:**
   - Register using your mobile number and OTP, then follow the same state and hospital selection flow as ORS.

3. **SMS Booking:**
   - Send an SMS in the format: `APPOINTMENT <PATIENT NAME>` to **8887019134**.

4. **Walk-in Registration:**
   - Visit the hospital ticket counter with your Aadhaar number and an active mobile number.
   - Complete verification via OTP, receive a physical token, pay the ₹50 fee, and collect your OPD slip. *(Note: The parchi/ticket counter closes at 1:00 PM sharp).*

**Important OPD Details:**
- **Timings:** Monday to Friday (9:00 AM – 1:00 PM) and Saturday (9:00 AM – 12:00 PM). Closed on Sundays.
- **Referral:** Outside-city patients must bring a valid referral for their specific department.

KGMU में विभिन्न मेडिकल, डेंटल, नर्सिंग और पैरामेडिकल कोर्सेस (जैसे MBBS, BDS, MD, MS, MCh, DM, B.Sc. नर्सिंग आदि) में प्रवेश आमतौर पर राष्ट्रीय स्तर की प्रवेश परीक्षाओं (जैसे NEET UG, NEET PG, NEET SS आदि) और विश्वविद्यालय द्वारा आयोजित प्रवेश परीक्षाओं के माध्यम से होता है। 

कृपया अपने पसंदीदा कोर्स के अनुसार पात्रता और आवेदन प्रक्रिया की विस्तृत जानकारी के लिए आधिकारिक वेबसाइट पर विजिट करें।

entries.question: how to pre booking
entries.answer:
To pre-book an OPD appointment at KGMU and avoid long wait times, you can use any of the following digital methods:

### 1. Online Registration System (ORS) Portal
- Visit the official portal at [ors.gov.in](https://ors.gov.in).
- Log in or register using your mobile number.
- Select **Uttar Pradesh** as your state and choose **King George's Medical University (KGMU)** from the hospital list.
- Choose **New Appointment**, select your required department, preferred date, and available time slot.
- Enter the patient's details and complete the payment of the **₹50** OPD slip fee.
- Download and save your appointment slip.

### 2. ABHA / Health Care App
- Open your ABHA-linked healthcare app on your smartphone.
- Register or log in using your mobile number and the OTP received.
- Follow the state and hospital selection flow (select Uttar Pradesh, then KGMU).
- Select your department, date, fill in the patient information, and pay the ₹50 fee to get your digital slip.

### 3. SMS Booking
- Send an SMS in the exact format: `Appointment [Patient Name]` to **8887019134**. 
- Follow any automated prompts or instructions received via SMS to confirm your booking.

**Important Tips for Pre-Booking:**
- OPD Timings are Monday to Friday (9:00 AM–1:00 PM) and Saturday (9:00 AM–12:00 PM). It is closed on Sundays.
- If you are traveling from outside Lucknow, remember to carry a valid referral letter for the specific department you are visiting.
